name: cascade_delete
description: In `app.Delete("/api/customers/:c_custkey<int>", ...)`, the handler explicitly deletes all orders with `DELETE FROM orders WHERE o_custkey = ?` before deleting the customer. However, the `/api/orders` endpoint only returns orders tied to active customers (`WHERE o_custkey IN (SELECT c_custkey FROM customer)`), so the child rows are not independently needed after the parent is gone. This is not an unsafe cascade because no other endpoint requires these orphaned orders to exist.
